caption:
Household debt just hit $19.1 trillion. 😬

The New York Fed data covered by NBC News shows it grew $334 billion in one quarter. Credit cards alone are at $1.29 trillion.

Meanwhile the savings rate has slipped below 4% of income.

Are you saving more, less, or the same as last year?
first_comment: Be honest: is your savings account growing or shrinking this year? 👇
